goal: Close the four team-owned validation gaps, fix proven defects, publish, and verify the exact public release.

intent_model.literal_request: Remember the gap list, do what depends on us, and return only after publication, testing and correctness.
intent_model.implied_outcome: Durable automated coverage rather than another one-time spot check, with no regression introduced by publication.
likely_rejections: A representative sample is called complete
A flaky tool result is confused with a product bug
A version is published before tests pass
A prior online booking, pricing, slider or mobile gallery capability regresses

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Complete catalog coverage, safe control coverage, gallery harness stability and repeated performance measurements without waiting for external permissions.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Each of the four owned gaps needs reproducible evidence and a final public retest.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Publication is authorized only after candidate gates pass and is not completion until the exact public version is retested.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Require candidate identity, deployment identity, rollback and post-publication evidence.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: One release decision backed by four evidence lanes.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Publish only if catalog, controls, gallery and performance pass without critical regression.

facts.claim: Release 567 passed representative public checks but left four team-owned evidence gaps.
The existing mobile gallery audit can lose its Playwright execution context while scrolling.
facts.evidence: The simulated-Adir audit recorded Cannot find context with specified id while the independent Claude run passed.

assumptions.claim: Live catalog and sitemap enumeration can be performed with bounded read-only requests.
assumptions.validation: Measure request count and stop on throttling or service degradation.

in_scope: Safe public control inventory and interaction audit
Smallest causal repair for any proven defect
Candidate build, public publication and exact-version regression
out_of_scope: Media-rights provenance that requires supplier records
invariants: Search and filters retain existing semantics
Event and holiday sliders continue beyond the first visible cards
Localized pages never show a blank bootstrap screen
No booking, payment, contact or administrative mutation is triggered by tests
affected_family: Public catalog APIs and sitemap URLs
Safe visible controls across public templates
Shared search, cards, sliders and availability presentation

requirements.statement: Enumerate and validate the discoverable public catalog with per-world totals and entity-level failures.
Inventory and exercise every safe public control family, while classifying side-effect boundaries explicitly.
Make the mobile gallery audit stable across clean contexts and repeated runs without weakening product assertions.
Measure cold and warm performance repeatedly and distinguish transient outliers from stable defects.
Publish only a passing candidate and verify the exact public release with a rollback identity.

acceptance_checks.setup: Production catalog and sitemap endpoints are read-only and reachable
acceptance_checks.action: Enumerate worlds and entity URLs with bounded concurrency
acceptance_checks.observable_result: A machine-readable report lists checked counts, status, image decode and link failures without silent omissions.

acceptance_checks.setup: Representative route for every public template at desktop and 390px
acceptance_checks.action: Activate each safe control family by pointer, touch or keyboard as applicable
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Each control records an observable state change, boundary state or explicit excluded external action.

acceptance_checks.setup: Fresh browser context and mobile vacation business page
acceptance_checks.action: Run the full gallery journey twice in isolated contexts
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Both runs pass arrows, swipe guard, grid, return, focus, RTL/LTR, low height, resize, Escape and main-gallery checks without context loss.

acceptance_checks.setup: Core public routes and bounded request budget
acceptance_checks.action: Collect multiple cold and warm navigation samples
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The report contains sample count, p50, p95, max, errors and cache headers per route; repeated severe outliers block release.

acceptance_checks.setup: Candidate gates pass and previous public version identity is recorded
acceptance_checks.action: Publish and reopen the exact public routes in fresh contexts
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Deployment identity and commit are recorded, critical invariants pass, and the previous version remains an identified rollback target.

acceptance_checks.action: Reload core desktop/mobile routes and repeat one search and one gallery journey
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The verified behavior persists after reload without blank, stale or error state.

acceptance_checks.setup: A catalog request, interaction assertion, gallery context or performance budget fails
acceptance_checks.action: Preserve the exact failure and run at most one discriminating retry after a causal change
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The release remains blocked until the mechanism is repaired and the affected family passes; no repeated blind retry occurs.

authorization_boundary: Local changes, safe read-only production probes, publication and post-publication verification are authorized. Side-effect flows and privileged mutations remain excluded.
